text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — final prep for Wed webinar 'Serving Inference at Scale'. Need decisions on reg page segmentation, Zoom recording settings, captions, RTMP fallback, clip extraction, and lead routing. Who can take ownership for each?
sam: I can own lead routing. Quick Q: do we want to pass 'interest-level' dropdown to SFDC or infer via session duration? I vote both.
mike: I'll own Zoom ops. Preference: cloud recording + audio transcript enabled, record active speaker + gallery. Enable alternative hosts: @viv and @elaine. Set cloud recording to auto-start.
jordan: For consent/legal: add checkbox 'I agree to be recorded and contacted' + link to privacy policy. We'll need that on reg page and in the reminder email.
viv: I'll update the registration page — two-tier CTA: 'Attend live' vs 'Get recording'. A/B test copy. Also will add 1-line consent under submit button.
sam: For SFDC mapping — zapier mapping: 
```
email -> Lead.Email
first_name -> Lead.FirstName
interest -> Lead.Campaign__c
source -> Lead.LeadSource
duration -> Lead.Webinar_Attendance__c
```
Also need lead owner rules: MQL -> AE queue, otherwise SDR.
elaine: Good. Mike, RTMP fallback — can we get an RTMP target in the account in case Zoom fails? Last time we used a VM with nginx-rtmp.
mike: We can enable RTMP. Need @eng-platform for the endpoint. Otherwise fallback to YouTube private stream. RTMP will record to S3 via the ingestion pipeline.
eng-platform-bot: Created test RTMP endpoint: rtmp://rtmp-test.redwood-internal/stream123. Expires in 7 days. Test meeting scheduled for Tue 2pm — invite sent.
jordan: Recording transcripts: prefer vendor Rev for higher accuracy. We'll upload cloud recording to S3 and trigger Rev via lambda. Filename pattern: event_{ts}_{title}.json
sam: Nurture flow — post-event sequence:
1) Immediately: thank you + recording link (if opted)
2) 24h: clip + slide deck + CTA to benchmark doc
3) 7d: targeted follow-up by interest segment
We should tag registrants with 'watched_25/50/75' in SFDC.
viv: For clips, what length? Marketing favors 45-90s highlight clips. We need timestamps tagged during the event: assign 'clip wrangler' to mark via Zoom's chat markers or use OBS scene markers.
mike: I'll run 'clip wrangler' (me) with co-pilot Sam. We'll also enable automatic highlight generation in Otter/Rev.
elaine: Can we automate routing so that any registrant from enterprise domain goes to enterprise SDR? Sam, add rule: if email endswith @company.com AND job_title contains 'Director|VP|Head', route to AE. Else queue to SDR.
sam: Yep. I'll add the Salesforce assignment rule and a Zap filter. Will test with a dummy lead.
viv: Design note — create 16:9 hero for replay thumbnail and three social clips (30s/60s/90s). I'll drop assets to Figma tonight.
jordan: Reminders: 24h + 1h email and calendar invite with dial-in. Also enable passcode in Zoom to avoid bombers. Put passcode in confirmation email.
elaine: Action items: mike = Zoom & RTMP test (Tue 2pm), sam = SFDC mapping + assignment rules, viv = reg page + assets, jordan = consent text + transcript pipeline, me = final copy + email templates. Tag me when done. :thumbsup:
